apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.long-content: The badge text is the fixed High, Medium or Low label from AUDIENCE_INTENT_BADGE_STYLES; no caller text reaches it, and DotBadge keeps the pill on one line. The detector matched the label field.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.partial: DashboardCard is a layout surface whose only data is children; variant, padding, hover and the ARIA passthroughs are presentation options with defaults, so nothing can be partially present.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.permission-denied: The card gates nothing: the detector matched its role ARIA passthrough prop. Any locked content is the caller's children, which certify their own permission states.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.partial: status is the only data; size and className are presentation options with defaults, so the badge is drawn whole or not at all. Small and AllStatuses already render with optional props left out.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.long-content: The badge text is one of four fixed labels from MATCH_STATUS_BADGE_STYLES (longest Auto-confirmed, shown in AllStatuses); no caller text reaches it. The detector matched the label field.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/i.empty: InsightActions always renders the same Dismiss and Done pair for one insight id and owns no collection; the detector matched the items-center class.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/i.long-content: Both labels are fixed copy (Dismiss, Done) and the only prop is the insight id, so no caller text reaches the buttons; the detector matched text- size classes.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/i.empty: InsightCard renders exactly one insight record and owns no collection; the detector matched the items-start and items-center classes. The empty insight list is InsightsPanel's Empty and EmptyCategory stories.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/i.long-content: The chip draws one fixed aria-hidden glyph per category and lays out no text, so nothing can grow; the detector matched its text- colour class.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.permission-denied: Anyone who can open the contacts editor can delete a contact; the dialog gates nothing. The detector matched the contact's role field, which only names the contact in the description.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.empty: ContactListRow renders exactly one contact and owns no collection; the detector matched the items-center class. A contact with no person, email or territory is PartialRoleOnly.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.permission-denied: The row is a plain select button with no gated action; the detector matched the contact's role field, which is only its label.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.partial: relativePath is the only data; the labels, icon and callbacks are presentation options with defaults, so the button is drawn whole or not at all. Default renders with every optional label at its default.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.offline: Copying writes to the local clipboard with no network request, so it behaves the same offline; the detector matched the loading-style isCopying flag. A refused clipboard is ErrorClipboardRefused.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.error: The button has no failure state of its own: it runs the caller's onRefresh (router.refresh in DashboardAnalytics) inside startTransition, and a failed refresh surfaces through that route's error boundary. The detector matched startTransition.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.offline: No request belongs to the button; an offline refresh fails in the caller's route refresh and its error boundary, not here. LoadingRefreshPending shows the only state the button draws while a refresh is in flight.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.empty: The card shows one fixed error message for a section and owns no collection; the detector matched the items-center class.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/m.partial: state and status are two ways to pass one of three save states, plus className; a status record with no flag set renders the reserved invisible idle container, which SettingsStatusPill.test.tsx asserts, so no data can be partially shown.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The list makes no request and has no failure state: rows arrive from AnalyticsSidebar, which owns the failed-fetch state (ErrorSevenDayFetch, DidNotLoad). The detector matched the catch in formatRankedLabel, which keeps an undecodable label as written (asserted in AnalyticsRankedList.certificate.test.tsx).
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The list never fetches; its loading flag comes from AnalyticsSidebar, whose OfflinePausedFirstLoad story shows a paused offline load as this list's skeleton.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: The module is a context provider and hook that render no UI of their own; children pass through untouched, and the detector matched the children prop. The panels and controls that consume it certify their own long-content states.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.rtl-overflow: The providers draw nothing: they only hold which audience panel is open, so there is no layout to mirror. The detector matched the children prop.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: Detector false positive: SIDEBAR_STEP_KEYS lists 'plan' as a loading-shell step key; the wrapper has no plan or permission gate.
Detector false positive: the sidebar step list has { id: 'upgrade', label: 'Plan' }; the handle step has no plan or permission gate.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: The hydrator returns null and lays out no text; link titles and the display name it hands to PreviewPanelContext are drawn by the profile rail, which certifies its own long-content states. The detector matched title and displayName fields.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.rtl-overflow: It renders nothing (PreviewDataHydrator.certificate.test.tsx asserts an empty container), so there is no layout to mirror; the profile rail it registers owns direction.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: Copy is fixed: "Traffic Quality Filtering" with "High quality only" / "All traffic"; no user-supplied text renders.
Copy is fixed: THEME_OPTIONS labels and descriptions plus "High Contrast"; no user-supplied text renders.
